restaurant_name: คลินิกทันตกรรมเดนทัลไทม์ Dental Time
text:
While traveling through northern Thailand, I spent a few nights in the Mae Wang District, about 30 minutes from Chiang Mai Old City. I was experiencing a bad toothache and needed a general cleaning after a few months of traveling.

I was fortunate to find a flyer for this clinic at a local café, advertising a grand opening sale, which was perfect timing for me. I decided to get a cleaning, X-ray, and check-up because it was affordable and gave me peace of mind.

The dentist and reception staff spoke excellent English, making the entire experience smooth and comfortable. The clinic is very clean and modern.

Whether you are traveling or a local, I highly recommend this dentist.
Thank you, Dr. Mai, for making my pain disappear!

text:
I had a dental scaling service, and I have to say I was very impressed from the moment I stepped into the clinic. The first thing I noticed was how clean the shop was. Everything looked neat and tidy, and the equipment was neatly arranged.

When it was time for my dental work, the dentist and assistants were very attentive, explaining the procedures in detail and performing the scaling gently. I felt no pain at all throughout the procedure, and most importantly, there was no bleeding, demonstrating their expertise.

The dentist was also very knowledgeable about dental and oral care, offering many helpful tips. And, impressively, the price was definitely worth it.

Overall, my dental experience at this clinic was excellent. The cleanliness, service, attentiveness, knowledge, and price were all excellent. If you're in the Mae Wang area and looking for a dental clinic, I highly recommend this place. You won't be disappointed.
